title: Extension point
description: An extension point (schema/extension-points/<name without namespace>.json): a public interface of the package that implementations of other packages implement, how many of them run, filter fields that select them and an optional fallback class.

interface.description: A public interface of the package. Implementations implement it.

use.description: single: exactly one implementation runs; multiple: all matching active implementations run in order.

filters.description: Fields whose values select the implementations, in their order. Each has exactly one of dataElement and domain.

default.description: Values of implementations that do not name the field. Without default every implementation names it.

fallback.description: A class of the package that implements the interface and runs when no implementation matches; null for none.

commitAllowed.description: Whether implementations may commit or roll back the default session. Default false.
